skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — convert my podcast audio into a video with waveform animation and captions...

latestVersion.changelog:
Podcast-to-video skill initial release.

- Instantly convert podcast audio (MP3, WAV, M4A, etc.) into captioned videos with waveform animations — no editing required.
- Handles uploads up to 500MB and generates 1080p MP4 videos in 1–3 minutes.
- Guides users through setup, including automatic backend token handling and cloud session creation.
- Offers quick access to credits, project state, exporting, and editing directly through chat commands or file uploads.
- Built-in error handling and tips for optimizing upload and output quality.
- Designed for podcasters and creators seeking fast audio-to-video workflows without professional editing software.
